topic.title: Pretrained Models with Commercially Restricted Data
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Are pretrained models released under a commercially permissive license (e.g. MIT) eligible if some of the data used by the original authors to train the publicly released checkpoint has non-commercial restrictions, assuming competitors do not themselves use or redistribute that restricted dataset?

comments.content: Thank you for bringing up this question. The main question with model weights is whether the license for the data in question allows redistribution (even noncommercial redistribution) of derivatives like model weights.  If so, then you should be fine to use it.
